bibl.title: An Inscription from the Reign of Probus: Reflections on the Port of Berenike in the Third Century CE
bibl.seg: Rodney Ast, An Inscription from the Reign of Probus: Reflections on the Port of Berenike in the Third Century CE.
Pylon. Editions and Studies of Ancient Texts 5 (2024) §1-17, figg.
bibl.note: Private dedication, likely to either Isis or Sarapis, from the reign of Probus (276-281 CE, November 17/18). Found in the northwest corner of the Isis temple courtyard at the port of Berenike.
